# Contributing

Thanks for your interest in Hero Synergy.

- **Open an issue first.** Describe the bug or the idea before writing code. A pull request without an issue may be closed.
- **This repository plans its own work in its Issues**, with [Matt Pocock's wayfinder skill](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills). That's why you'll see `wayfinder:*` and triage labels such as `needs-triage` and `ready-for-agent`.
- **To build, check and test**, follow [Developing](../README.md#developing) in the README.
- **A change people will notice in the extension needs a changeset**: run `pnpm changeset` and write it for the person updating.

For a security problem, see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
